description.zh: 实例的自定义密钥ID，可调用[DescribeEncryptionKeyList](~~473860~~)接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the custom key. You can call the [DescribeEncryptionKeyList](~~473860~~) operation to query the ID of the key.
The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

title.zh: 查询实例的TDE自定义密钥详情

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口时，要求实例已通过自定义密钥的方式开启了数据加密TDE（Transparent Data Encryption）功能，相关接口，请参见[ModifyInstanceTDE](~~473859~~)。


> 关于透明数据加密TDE的详细介绍及注意事项，请参见[开启透明数据加密TDE](~~265913~~)。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, TDE must be enabled for the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance by using a custom key. For more information, see [ModifyInstanceTDE](~~473859~~).

> For more information about TDE, see [Enable TDE](~~265913~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore describe-encryption-key --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --encryption-key ad463061-992d-4195-8a94-ed6300000000 --region cn-hangzhou
